correctness.rationale: For every \(n\ge1\), the prime-support condition on \(q\) and \(\gcd(r,uv)=1\) imply \(\gcd(qn+r,uv)=1\). Multiplicativity gives exact factorizations of both divisor sums, so \(\sigma_s(u)<\sigma_s(v)\) proves the permanent strict inequality. Both proposed divisibility conclusions are equivalent to \(u\mid v\). The cases \(s>0\), \(s<0\), and \(s=0\) are exhaustive. The finite verifier is not used to infer the universal statement.
